# Building Your First WebAssembly Module
```rust
// In src/lib.rs
// use wasm_bindgen::prelude::*;
//
// #[wasm_bindgen]
// pub fn add(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 {
//     a + b
// }
```

Build the npm package:

```bash
wasm-pack build --target web
```
